info.title: Matomo Reporting API for CustomDimensions plugin

get.description: Fetch a report for the given idDimension. Only reports for active dimensions can be fetched. Requires at least view access.

Configures a new Custom Dimension. Note that Custom Dimensions cannot be deleted, be careful when creating one as you might run quickly out of available Custom Dimension slots. Requires at least Admin access for the specified website. A current list of available `$scopes` can be fetched via the API method `CustomDimensions.getAvailableScopes()`. This method will also contain information whether actually Custom Dimension slots are available or whether they are all already in use.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The idSite the dimension shall belong to

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Either 'visit' or 'action'. To get an up to date list of availabe scopes fetch the API method `CustomDimensions.getAvailableScopes`

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: '0' if dimension should be inactive, '1' if dimension should be active

parameters.name: extractions
parameters.description: Either an empty array or if extractions shall be used one or multiple extractions the format array(array('dimension' => 'url', 'pattern' => 'index_(.+).html'), array('dimension' => 'urlparam', 'pattern' => '...')) Supported dimensions are  eg 'url', 'urlparam' and 'action_name'. To get an up to date list of supported dimensions request the API method `CustomDimensions.getAvailableExtractionDimensions`. Note: Extractions can be only set for dimensions in scope 'action'.

parameters.name: caseSensitive
parameters.description: '0' if extractions should be applied case insensitive, '1' if extractions should be applied case sensitive

200.description: Returns the ID of the configured dimension. Note that the same idDimension will be used for different websites.

get.description: Updates an existing Custom Dimension. This method updates all values, you need to pass existing values of the dimension if you do not want to reset any value. Requires at least Admin access for the specified website.

parameters.name: idDimension
parameters.description: The id of a Custom Dimension.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The idSite the dimension belongs to

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: '0' if dimension should be inactive, '1' if dimension should be active

parameters.name: extractions
parameters.description: Either an empty array or if extractions shall be used one or multiple extractions the format array(array('dimension' => 'url', 'pattern' => 'index_(.+).html'), array('dimension' => 'urlparam', 'pattern' => '...')) Supported dimensions are  eg 'url', 'urlparam' and 'action_name'. To get an up to date list of supported dimensions request the API method `CustomDimensions.getAvailableExtractionDimensions`. Note: Extractions can be only set for dimensions in scope 'action'.

parameters.name: caseSensitive
parameters.description: '0' if extractions should be applied case insensitive, '1' if extractions should be applied case sensitive, null to keep case sensitive unchanged

get.description: Get a list of all configured CustomDimensions for a given website. Requires at least Admin access for the specified website.

Get a list of all supported scopes that can be used in the API method `CustomDimensions.configureNewCustomDimension`. The response also contains information whether more Custom Dimensions can be created or not. Requires at least Admin access for the specified website.

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
value	name	numSlotsAvailable	numSlotsUsed	numSlotsLeft	supportsExtractions
visit	Visit	15	1	14	0
action	Action	15	5	10	1

get.description: Get a list of all available dimensions that can be used in an extraction. Requires at least Admin access to one website.

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
value	name
url	Page URL
urlparam	Page URL Parameter
action_name	Page Title
